topic.source_contract: Ordnance Survey National Geographic Database physical and functional geometry

facts.scope_guard: OS NGD is authoritative physical and functional mapping, not land-registration title or planning permission.
API filtering capability is not evidence that a candidate query, intersection or area calculation was executed.
Land-cover classification is physical context and not land use permission, ownership or developable area.
Mapped access points and land-use status do not establish a legal right of access, planning entitlement or redevelopment readiness.
A mapped link-node network is not highway adoption, private easement, title access or guaranteed site access.

scope_guards: OS NGD is authoritative national mapping data but is not HM Land Registry title evidence.
Buildings, land cover and structures describe physical features and do not establish planning entitlement.
Land-cover polygons and land-use sites remain separate semantic layers and are not interchangeable.
Active, inactive, derelict or unknown mapped status is not evidence of permission, vacancy, contamination or redevelopment commencement.
Mapped site access points do not establish a private easement, public-highway status or unrestricted legal access.
Transport link-node connectivity does not prove legal access from a candidate parcel.
API, download and daily-update capability do not prove an executed candidate-specific spatial query.
No score or promotion is written without exact candidate geometry, HMLR title relation, executed OS query and current statutory evidence.
